references.text: Repeats that Samson judged Israel for twenty years and confirms the duration of his service as a judge
Introduces the Philistine oppression of Israel, which is the context for Samson's service as a judge
Describes how the Lord raised up judges to save Israel from the hand of their enemies
Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life, a similar pattern for judicial service
Eli had judged Israel for forty years, another example of long-term judicial service
Paul mentions the period of the judges in Israel's history, including the time when Samson served
